I will try to look into implementing FSR in the future for AMD cards but at the moment it is too unstable.

notes.title: Nuclear Nightmare V2.4 / Resurrection Finale Update
notes.content:
Features/Major Changes:
- Revamped/remastered underground location lighting & textures
- Vehicle Horns (Press H)
- New flamethrower sounds + Flamethrower stall logic: If the flamethrower is under 50% it may randomly stall when trying to turn it on for the first time.
- Reworked playable enemy: Right click to lunge has been replaced with ability to override attack cooldown, paired with a new model and animations. Disabled ability to be reinforced if you spawn as a playable enemy, however never spawn playable enemy has been turned off by default in world settings to avoid confusion)
- New head spider model + head spiders scream when burnt!
- You can now hold a flashlight and revolver or flare gun at the same time + new flashlight model & animations
- Persistent gas stations & soda machines across entire map (This means you can't load back in a area you have already been to and use the soda machine again or have the gas station fuel level reset)
- Damage Overhaul (Includes improved hitboxes & changes to how damage is dealt to enemies) 
- Probability item spawns (Items are not just spawned completely randomly anymore, each item has a probability to spawn. For example powerful weapons like snipers and other ammo types are more rare to find than a gas canister. With this being the case, items like revolvers and mp5s were given a significant buff)
- Mimics drop items

Fixes/Improvements:
- Faster camera animation rotation during cutscenes
- Adjusted streaming granularity for lower end pcs
- Revolver aiming improved
- Flare gun aiming improved
- Removed lumen hardware ray tracing (Significant performance boost)
- Overall rendering optimizations
- Dog death ragdolls improved
- Dropping Ammo causes ammo to go in negatives if spamming the drop button (fixed)
- Item hp bar UI change
- Inventory UI not appearing for clients with high latency (fixed)
- Snowcat glass flashing fix
- Laser is droppable when not placed correctly (automatically snaps to the ground)
- New slaughter house textures
- Updated evac computer UI
- New pickaxe model
- New husk sounds

notes.content:
Hello researchers. The AISF has released new documents regarding potential changes in the arctic environments.
Mother nature has brought a lot of changes and fixes for you all, so lets dive right in.

📢 - **Overview**
- New mimic enemy.
- New weapon, the MP5!

- The helicopter no longer slides.

- SIGNIFICANT AI optimizations (10x in some cases).
- Vehicles now teleport you outside the door when leaving, as opposed to clipping you inside.
- Rare issue where players could not use the laptop after respawning.
- Fixed an occasional issue where the perk save file could get corrupted.

- The sniper scope now uses your screen, increasing performance greatly.
- Added new damage framework internally, allowing us to make objects do things when hit with ease.
- Lasers are based on distance for length.
- Red canisters can now be shot to explode.
- The generator can be turned off with a pickaxe.
- More UI improvements, should scale properly on larger screens.
- Dead AI's should no longer function after 60 seconds.
- Extraction has been improved.
- Upon being called, the helicopter has a 60 second "landing period"

- If half the researchers enter the circle in this 5 minute, the timer goes to one minute.
- At the end of the minute, all researchers who are outside the circle will not evacuate.
